title: Vertex AI Model gives error on system message input and connected text input
body:
### Bug Description

When adding system message and input via for example prompt builder I am receiving error.

Error Message:
Error Building Component:
Error building Component Vertex AI: Expected mapping type as input to ChatPromptTemplate. Received <class 'list'>.

### Reproduction

Connected Input, no System message
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/313999f5-23f5-403a-a4cd-d4d14ddd5349)

No connected Input + system message
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cd8ada53-d9e3-451b-82d7-a0c3f22d3808)

Connected Input + system message
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e5027d98-c188-4a2c-a5a6-090efa0c1157)

### Expected behavior

It should not give errors

### Who can help?

_No response_

### Operating System

Windows 11

### Langflow Version

1.0.12

### Python Version

None

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves prompt management problems with the ChatPromptTemplate and system message input, which are tied to LLM operation and prompt-related issues, aligning with the definition of an agent issue.
